value.title: Phase 1
value.summary: Three ordered tasks: diagnose npm replay, reproduce/fix worktree teardown, then prove the composed branch.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Execute in order. Preserve operator npm config; any skip must print a verified machine condition. Capture RED-first and fresh-worktree tmux transcripts.

value.title: Diagnose and correct the npm-resolution replay failure; if it is a machine condition, skip only with a verified reason printed in test output.
value.note: Prime ruling: widen scope; npm >=11.10.0 is required for native enforcement, older npm must fail closed with a named error.
value.receipt: Prime widened scope; npm 11.5.1 now fails closed below native 11.10.0 support; TLS fixture fixed; artifact://76.

value.title: Reproduce the worktree cleanup ENOTEMPTY failure on the pre-fix tree, then fix teardown within the named worktree paths.
value.receipt: Node rmSync teardown now retries transient ENOTEMPTY; 30/30 targeted runs passed.

value.title: Run fresh-worktree just test in tmux, harness checks, capture transcripts, and close all acceptance criteria.
value.receipt: Transcript assets/live-proof.md; harness checks status ok, all sensors pass.

tk-0001.assertion: Targeted npm integration test either passes or reports a named, verified machine-condition skip; full fresh-worktree just test remains green.
tk-0001.receipt: RED artifact://73; GREEN artifact://76: 14/14 tests passed; just typecheck passed.

tk-0002.assertion: Pre-fix ENOTEMPTY is captured and the same targeted worktree test passes after the teardown fix.
tk-0002.receipt: RED: repeat 6 failed ENOTEMPTY in afterEach; GREEN: 30 sequential targeted runs, 210 tests, zero failures.

tk-0003.assertion: Fresh-worktree just test and harness checks exit 0; the tmux transcript is pasted into assets/live-proof.md.
tk-0003.receipt: tmux just test: 231 files passed, 4645 tests passed, exit 0; harness checks: 8/8 sensors passed, 0 skipped at 2026-09-02T03:38:32.086Z.
